APP.headline: APP Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Model Gains and Growth Outlook
APP.description: AppLovin (APP) reported Q3 2026 revenues of $2.18 billion, up 55% year-over-year, driven by new AI models that improved advertising performance. The company forecasts Q4 revenues of $2.365-$2.395 billion with 43-44% growth and EBITDA margins of 84-85%. Gaming ad revenues grew nearly 50%, while consumer ad spending surged triple digits. Management maintains a long-term annual growth target of approximately 30% and generated $1.4 billion in quarterly free cash flow.

APP.headline: HAGENS BERMAN, NATIONAL SECURITIES LAW FIRM, Reminds AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ: APP) Investors of Class Action and November 16, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
APP.description: Hagens Berman is investigating AppLovin Corporation for alleged securities law violations, claiming the company misled investors about the readiness and performance of its AI models and self-service ad tools. AppLovin's stock plummeted 19.6% on August 6, 2026, after the company reported missed revenue estimates and acknowledged significant developmental delays in its generative AI video tools. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

APP.headline: ROSEN, LEADING TRIAL ATTORNEYS, Encourages Duolingo, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - DUOL
APP.description: Several securities class action lawsuits have been filed against major companies. Duolingo faces allegations of misleading statements regarding user growth metrics and product quality degradation from AI-generated content. Coastal Financial faces scrutiny over BaaS credit risk management with shares down 43%. AppLovin, Better Home & Finance, and LKQ are also subject to ongoing investigations and class actions with various lead plaintiff deadlines in November and December 2026.

APP.headline: AppLovin Turns 81% of New Sales Into Profit: Rapid Earnings Reaction
APP.description: AppLovin reported strong Q3 2026 results with 55% revenue growth to $2.18 billion and 72% net income growth to $1.44 billion. The ad platform converted 81% of new revenue into operating income despite doubling research spending. However, free cash flow growth lagged earnings growth due to higher tax payments. Q4 guidance projects continued momentum with steady margins.

APP.headline: Kaplan Fox Alerts Investors of AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ: APP) to an Upcoming Deadline of November 16, 2026 in the Securities Class Action
APP.description: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation for investors who purchased securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026. The complaint alleges that AppLovin made false statements about its generative AI video creative feature, which faced significant development delays, and overstated improvements to its AI models. APP.headline: APPLOVIN DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
APP.description: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased APP securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

EPAM.headline: Epam (EPAM) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
EPAM.description: EPAM Systems reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.51 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.41, with revenues of $1.43 billion slightly exceeding expectations. However, the stock has declined 33% year-to-date compared to the S&P 500's 12.3% gain. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

EPAM.headline: Taboola.com Ltd. (TBLA) Meets Q3 Earnings Estimates
EPAM.description: Taboola.com (TBLA) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.14 per share, matching consensus estimates, but revenues of $462.26 million missed expectations by 0.91%. The stock has underperformed the market by 26.3% year-to-date. With a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and mixed estimate revisions, the stock is expected to perform in line with the market. The company's Computers - IT Services industry ranks in the top 46% of Zacks industries.

ADT.headline: ADT: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
ADT.description: ADT has agreed to be acquired by private equity firm Thrive Holdings for $10 per share in cash, representing a 46-52% premium to recent trading prices. The deal values ADT at $7.6 billion and is expected to close in Q1 2027, pending regulatory approval. ADT reported strong operational performance with year-to-date free cash flow exceeding $1 billion through three quarters, and announced new partnerships including installation and service support for Apple Retail and expansion to Walmart.com.

RIOT.headline: Riot Platforms, Inc. (RIOT) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
RIOT.description: Riot Platforms reported Q3 2026 revenue of $181.43 million, beating consensus estimates by 12.37%, with EPS of $0.01 versus an estimated -$0.34. Bitcoin mining revenue declined 27.9% year-over-year to $115.99 million, though engineering revenue surged 146.2%. The stock has underperformed the broader market, declining 25.9% over the past month, and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

RIOT.headline: Riot Platforms, Inc. (RIOT) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
RIOT.description: Riot Platforms reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.01 per share, beating consensus estimates of -$0.34 loss, with revenues of $181.43 million exceeding expectations by 12.37%. However, the company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating due to mixed estimate revisions. The Financial - Miscellaneous Services industry ranks in the bottom 37% of sectors, which could impact future performance.

HUT.headline: HUT Q3 Earnings Call Focuses on AI Expansion and Project Financing
HUT.description: Hut 8 Corp. reported a Q3 2026 loss of $1.23 per share, missing consensus estimates, as revenues declined to $71.07M. However, the company secured $27B in AI data center leases representing 949 MW of capacity, with River Bend and Beacon Point Phase 1 deliveries targeted for 2027. Hut 8 secured $7.5B in nonrecourse project financing and expanded its share repurchase authorization to $1B, maintaining a disciplined capital strategy focused on converting contracted capacity into recurring revenues.

HUT.headline: As Democrats Take Control of Congress, Warren Buffett Has a Timely Warning for Investors
HUT.description: Following Democrats' 2026 midterm victory, Wall Street rallied with the Dow surging over 1,500 points. However, market sectors diverged sharply: AI hyperscalers like Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta surged, while semiconductor and data center stocks plunged amid concerns about tighter AI infrastructure oversight. Warren Buffett's investment philosophy advises against letting political uncertainty drive portfolio decisions, emphasizing that long-term business fundamentals should guide invest

CIFR.headline: Why Cipher Digital Stock Lost 53.9% in October
CIFR.description: Cipher Digital stock plummeted 53.9% in October due to AI sector financing concerns and an $850 million convertible debt offering that spooked investors. The company faces heavy borrowing needs ($6.7 billion debt) to fund its data center expansion, though it has $16.6 billion in contracted revenue with long-term leases. Key risks include construction cost pressures, Texas regulatory scrutiny, and a challenging credit environment that may limit future lease signings.
